dedupe_keys.name: ethiopia market centers eiar market centre dataset

description: This dataset maps market centres across Ethiopia, the towns and rural markets where agricultural produce and food are traded, with their locations and attributes. It was compiled by the Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research and is republished on the Humanitarian Data Exchange by the information management organisation 3iS, with the original held on the Ministry of Agriculture's data portal. Coverage is national, as a snapshot dated January 2025, delivered as a CSV table and a shapefile of points that can be joined to administrative boundaries and road networks. The data are free and released into the public domain (CC0). Caveats: the attributes do not include market size, days of operation or traded volumes, the update cycle is not stated, and the list may omit informal or seasonal markets. Simulation uses: building the market layer of food supply and distribution network models in Ethiopia, estimating travel time from farms and households to markets, and assessing how drought, conflict or road cuts would isolate food trade. Related records: WFP food market locations (data-wfp-food-market-locations) cover monitored price markets in Ethiopia and elsewhere, and FEWS NET (data-fews-net-data-explorer) supplies food security outlooks for the country.
